description: Runs the full teardown in order: two no-argument calls, restoring a saved longword in an object, four library calls on stored handles, and two more no-argument calls. Returns one afterwards.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:12E8A

description: Loops at most 32 times, asking a routine to check two stored handles and stopping early when both report nothing. Inside the loop a status value of four sets a flag, and a value of eight or 1024 triggers a further call on a shared record.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:12F5A

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:13242
name: free_double_bitplane_buffers

name: call_library_with_global_pointer
description: Passes a fixed argument of 5 and the address of a global block to a library function and returns.

description: Calls routines to read a value from a structure and to compute a size from two of its fields, passes the results on, and returns the reported value capped at 64000.

name: build_room_file_name_list

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:13566

description: Applies a lookup to each of the nine string slots in order and returns the first successful result. On a match it saves that slot's entry and shifts the earlier entries down one place, and it returns zero when no slot matches.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:13568
name: search_room_name_list
description: Searches the same nine-slot name list as its neighbour, applying a lookup to each entry in order and shifting the earlier entries down one place on a match. The referenced path templates show that it works with room file paths.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1368C

description: Draws the same bands as its neighbour, but the final band passes a flag of eight in a different argument position, selecting a flagged fill mode for that band.

name: copy_plane_with_blitter
description: Waits for the blitter, selects one of two plane buffers as source and the other as destination depending on a flag, and programs the blitter pointers, modulo, control and size registers for a copy 200 lines high and 20 words wide.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:13B2C
name: advance_byte_sequence_step
description: Flips a buffer selector and runs a routine. When a timing flag is set it advances a position in a fixed eight-entry byte table, storing the current entry into a shared value and wrapping after the eighth entry, with a library call on each step.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:13BDC

description: Rebuilds a 16-entry word table in place by replacing each entry with the table value at the index it currently holds, then passes two stored buffers with table offsets to a library routine.

name: compute_row_span_address

description: Adds a fixed 32-bit constant to a series of longwords spaced 160 bytes apart, starting at an address built from the parameter and stored bases, for a count taken from a shared value.

name: load_dma_channel_word
description: Looks up a record by index and copies its 16-bit field at a fixed offset into a shared word that goes to the DMA control register.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1414A
name: load_interrupt_control_word

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1416A

description: Looks up a record by index and copies one 16-bit field into a shared word twice, with the result feeding the interrupt enable and request registers.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1418A
name: copy_record_word_to_global
description: Looks up a record and copies the 16-bit field at a fixed offset into the shared word.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1418E
name: copy_word_for_register_index
description: Uses the index in the data register to look up a record, then copies its 16-bit field at a fixed offset into the shared word that feeds the interrupt request register.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:141A2
name: or_record_request_words
description: Looks up two records by index, ORs their 16-bit fields at the same offset together, stores the result in the shared word and returns it.

name: store_library_result_in_record
description: Looks up a record by the index in the data register, calls a library routine through a stored vector, and writes the 32-bit result into a fixed field of that record.

description: Calls a different library routine through a stored vector, in a gap of the file that is not reached from the program flow.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1431A

description: Resets an audio channel record by setting its length field to 124 and clearing a volume-like field, copies a control word from the record, runs a short busy loop, and decrements a shared timer entry when it is set.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:14396
name: advance_four_channel_timers
description: Walks four channel slots and, for each active one, adds its per-tick increments to two position fields and counts down two timers, clearing the start values when a timer runs out.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1442E
name: clamp_channel_length_field
description: Computes two channel fields from a record: the first is raised to at least 124, and the second is limited to a stored maximum and becomes zero when a shared flag is set.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1446E

description: Decrements a delay counter and, once it expires, runs a stored script of offset and value pairs: small offsets are written straight into the channel register area, larger ones count down a per-entry timer, and a terminator either stops the script or restarts it.

name: open_audio_device_with_buffers
description: Allocates eight 64-byte memory blocks, then creates an audio request structure and opens the audio device, returning a distinct error code for each step that fails and zero on success.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:1495E

description: Undoes the audio setup by closing the audio device and freeing the request structure and the eight 64-byte blocks, each only when it is present, and clears the setup flag as it goes.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:14A2C
name: refresh_two_indexed_slots
description: Passes two indices from its argument to a self-assignment on each of two shared table entries, then calls a routine with both indices, which changes nothing beyond that call.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:INDY:0:14A90
